title: Vectis Prime
extract:
The Vectis Prime is the Prime version of the  Vectis sniper rifle, featuring higher base damage, fire rate, and zoom, and a doubled magazine, but with a higher combo count requirement. It was released alongside  Ash Prime and Carrier Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Two zoom modes:
First zoom has 3.5x zoom distance and +40% headshot damage.
Second zoom has 6.0x zoom distance and +60% headshot damage.
Zoom is not cancelled during reload.
Staggers most enemies with every hit.
Innate  and  polarities.
Good candidate for  Charged Chamber and/or  Primed Chamber due to its magazine size of two rounds, or one round with  Depleted Reload.
Advantages over other Primary  Sniper Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Fastest reload speed of all sniper rifles.
Good ammo economy.
Pinpoint accuracy while zoomed in; shots will hit exactly on the reticle dot, perfect for headshots.
Innate 1 meter punch through.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On May 24th, 2017, it was announced that Vectis Prime, alongside  Ash Prime and Carrier Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on May 30th, 2017. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.
On October 12th 2017, Vectis Prime was obtainable as a Twitch Drop reward with The Great Eidolon Hunt event.
On October 16th, 2018, Vectis Prime,  Fang Prime and an exclusive Sugatra were released as Twitch Prime benefits.
On November 19, 2019, Vectis Prime was unvaulted as part of the Ash & Vauban Prime Vault; it re-entered the Prime Vault February 11, 2020.

Notes
Due to the fact that it has two rounds per magazine instead of the Vectis' single round,  Charged Chamber and  Primed Chamber are less effective without the use of manual reloading.
Manual reloading also cannot be optimally performed due to the recoil animation after the first shot, which prevents the performance of an immediate reload. This can be circumvented by using the  Depleted Reload mod, which reduces the magazine size of the Vectis Prime to 1, and increases reload speed (note, this alone will not affect reload delay, only the actual animation after the delay). However, this will slightly drop the weapon's DPS, due to the reload delay; a cursed riven, without fire rate or reload, will, in isolation, decrease it more strongly.
The Vectis Prime's forced Stagger counts as a status proc for  Galvanized Aptitude.
The Vectis Prime has superior zoom capabilities to the Vectis, having a 6x maximum magnification compared to the Vectis' 4.5, while still maintaining a 3.5x minimum zoom for mid-range shooting.
The Vectis Prime has the largest shot combo requirement of the sniper rifles, needing 5 shots to initiate the 1.5x damage multiplier.

Incarnon Genesis

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Vectis Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Vectis with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Vectis Prime requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 80  Eevani, and 150  Saggen Pearls.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. The following Evolution tiers, their requirements for unlocking them, and their related perks, are shown below;
Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Weakpoint hits charge Incarnon Transmutation; Alt Fire transmutes. Switching back will expend any remaining charge.
Mode switching is not instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's reload speed.
Incarnon Form is activated by filling the Incarnon Transmutation gauge that appears under the reticle by achieving weakpoint hits and then pressing the Alternate Fire button. 5 weakpoint hits will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form, but total Incarnon charges will be reduced if activating with a partial gauge.
Charges do not generate on the backpacks of most MOA variants, or vulnerability spots generated by  Sonar or  Detect Vulnerability in places other than natural weakpoints.
Weakpoints on corpses or Invulnerable targets do not build charges.
Individual Multishot bullets can build charges.
Note that one must unzoom to activate Incarnon form, since pressing Alternate Fire while zoomed will instead toggle the zoom level.
Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Vectis's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing 10 rounds to a maximum of 45. Once all ammunition is expended, the Vectis reverts to its normal form.
Incarnon Form's magazine is not affected by mods.
Incarnon Form is not affected by Ammo Efficiency (such as  Energized Munitions).
Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon death.
Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.

Evolutions

Trivia
Vectis is Latin for "Bar" or "Pole", referring to a locking bar (or bolt), a leveraging bar such as a Crowbar, or possibly referring to a carrying pole. Or that it's supposed to be a bolt action rifle
The Vectis Prime has a bipod, as opposed to the monopod on the normal Vectis. This might suggest that this rifle would be more precise and have less recoil because of the extra support from the bipod. It is purely cosmetic, however.
